new_findings: Unchanged K-3 II decoded bytes repack byte-identically to the original distribution package.
Primary 16 MiB checksum is little-endian at 0x1f0; secondary 0xf000-byte checksum is big-endian at 0x100007c.
Original decoder 0x8476cc agrees with the Python transform over the complete two-image package.
Command-7 sender 0x599fb8 and receiver 0xda078/0xda248 exchange a 32-bit additive sum. Sequential original CPU contexts reproduced the mailbox reply without supplying completion or result values.
A repaired checksum also accepts intentionally corrupted secondary code, demonstrating that structural acceptance does not prove program correctness.
Capability response 0x8205 writes CLensKaf2+6 only on transport success; original CAfLens bit-6 predicate drives both CAfMotor branches.
Six original AF cases distinguish bit 6, bit 7 and retained prior values on failure; three native model-profile dispatch cases also reproduce.
